text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Alright, everyone. As mentioned before, a 
charity event will be held at the academy. 
You all will be in charge of running it.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
You have free rein over what you do, so 
please decide on your activities within 
your groups. Go ahead and start your 
discussions.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
What should our group do? Does anyone have 
any suggestions?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... What do people usually do for 
charity? I haven't really been to many 
events like that.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Opening food stalls, holding bazaars... Or 
perhaps inviting artists to put on live 
performances, and things like that.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The profits generated there go toward 
donations. Since people can contribute to 
society while having fun, it's very easy 
to get lots of support!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Satono Group's charity knowledge is such a 
lifesaver~...! Plus, opening stalls sounds 
just like a school festival, so fun!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm honored if I can be of help! Please 
feel free to ask anytime!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's start nailing down the 
details right away!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Assuming we open a booth here... What 
should we sell?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Merchandise is nice, but food is where 
it's at! Food stalls are super popular at 
school festivals, right? Don't you think 
so too, Cheval-chan?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Eh, ah............ Y-Yeah. I think... 
that's good...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
How about carrot cookies? They can be 
mass-produced, and if wrapped nicely, 
they'd be easy to sell.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Sounds delicious~! But wait, if we're 
doing it, wouldn't carrot cake be better? 
Customers would be happier with something 
more filling!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
............Carrot cake............ huh. 
...Yeah, you're right. Sounds delicious.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Cheval-san, is something the matter...? 
You've seemed a bit hesitant for a while 
now...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
............No, not really, it's 
nothing...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Could it be... that you have an opinion?!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Eh?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You've been deep in thought this whole 
time, haven't you? I really want to hear 
your thoughts, Cheval-san!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
By sharing opinions, we can polish our 
rough ideas into gems! Let's make it great 
together!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah, I-I... I'm— ...~~Sorry!

While about to grab lunch during a break 
from work, I noticed Satono Diamond 
brooding by herself. I called out to ask 
what was wrong...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And so, I really wanted to hear her 
opinion, but I ended up making Cheval-san 
shrink into her shell.

If someone is unable to voice their 
thoughts, there could be several 
reasons... However, if there's something 
we can change first:
choice_data_list:
Why not aim to create an atmosphere where 
it's easy to talk?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Atmosphere... I see, earlier I must have 
made her feel unnecessarily nervous.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: . I will strive to improve on this...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...And that is the situation. As someone 
who interacts with students daily, 
Rudolf-san, I would love to hear your 
advice.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Humph... How to elicit frank and 
unreserved opinions from our fellow 
students is something I, too, am currently 
exploring.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why! I thought that you, 
Rudolf-san, would have already found a 
clue toward the solution.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Learning from below to reach 
higher—I would be glad if this serves as a 
step toward that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In my view, the key lies in 
approachability. Something embraced by the 
masses and cherished long-term... Yes—puns 
would make a splendid method.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...I see... 'Ten ants make ten-ks 
(thanks)'... like that!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...And so, I thought a tea party would be 
perfect for talking in a relaxed mood! 
Fragrant black tea and delicious sweets!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I was hoping that would help Cheval-san 
feel nice and cozy.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... With butlers present, and maids 
lined up in a row.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Even the teaware looks super expensive~... 
That'd just make anyone nervous~!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Eh, really? ...A blind spot. It's such a 
common sight for me that I didn't even 
think about it...!
